message.projecthero.ironman.mk6.surge_on: Arc Reactor Surge: +50% damage and speed.
message.projecthero.ironman.orbital_fall: The pod could not reach you. Suiting up from your pack.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.mark_6.body: 10500 energy (+2.6/s), 800 integrity, Resistance I, +7 melee, breathes underwater, targeting HUD, and every ability costs 40% less. R Repulsor (17; hold 1 s for 26), Sneak + R Repulsor Dash (22). G hold the 360-degree Repulsor Shield; Sneak + G Sonic Clap (22). X Arc Reactor Surge: 10 s of +50% damage and 50% faster flight and running, burning 150 energy a second, then a 40 s cooldown (X again ends it early); Sneak + X Flares. Z hold the Unibeam (24 per hit). V Shoulder Barrage: 6 homing missiles (20 each); Sneak + V coloured highlight. C store suit.
projecthero.guide.iron_man.mark_vii.body: 12000 energy (+3/s), 950 integrity, Resistance I, +8 melee, breathes underwater, targeting HUD, and every ability costs 40% less. Orbital drop: called off a Suit Platform, or from your pack while you are in the air, it streaks down from the sky in its delivery pod; if you are airborne or falling the pod catches you and clamps the suit on mid-air. R Repulsor (20; hold 1 s for 30), Sneak + R Repulsor Dash (25). G hold the 360-degree Repulsor Shield; Sneak + G Flares. V weapon wheel, X fires the pick: Micro-Missiles (6 x 26), Homing Missiles (4 x 26), Flamethrower (12/s), Wrist Laser (3 s beam), Rocket (40, area), supersonic flight or the coloured highlight. Z hold the Unibeam (28 per hit). C store suit.
